newsitem.title: USA: U.S. West Coast lt. crude price unchanged Thursday.
newsitem.headline: U.S. West Coast lt. crude price unchanged Thursday.

text.p: U.S. West Coast light crude prices were unchanged Thursday, in line with subdued futures markets and thin local trading, players said.
Crude oil for July delivery on the New York Mercantile Exchange (NYMEX) ended the same price as yesterday at West $21.86 a barrel.
As the deadline for pipeline scheduling approached, traders said EOTT Energy bought 2,000 barrels-per-day of crude from ARCO Pipeline for June delivery.
EOTT paid $3.50 a barrel under West Texas Intermediate/Cushing (WTI) crude, the U.S benchmark grade.
The deal follows another Line 63 sale yesterday, which saw Tosco buy at 70 cents over postings.
In heavy markets, trade was quiet following Texaco sale of heavy crude yesterday at 10 and 15 cents under postings.
Benchmark West Coast grade, Alaska North Slope (ANS), tracked flat futures, staying at $20/20.20 a barrel.
ANS discounts have remained flat at $1.50 a barrel under WTI, with BP, a leading seller, keeping its offer at minus $1.30 Tuesday.
